interest: This document provides valuable insight into U.S. State Department tracking of Japanese diplomatic, military, and propaganda activities in Western Europe following the Manchurian crisis. It highlights Tokyo's efforts to establish a centralized mission in Paris to coordinate continental press propaganda, seek diplomatic recognition for the puppet state of Manchukuo, and solicit foreign financial support. Additionally, the sheet serves as a crucial archival index connecting Japanese intelligence and influence operations in France with broader diplomatic files on Manchuria (such as 893.01-Manchuria/752).
overview: This file consists of a U.S. State Department List of Papers docket sheet for decimal file 894.20251, documenting Japanese military activities, espionage, and propaganda in France during 1933. The sheet indexes two records: an entry of November 20, 1933, noting Japanese propaganda in France evidenced by articles appearing in the press, and a telegram of January 10, 1933, from U.S. Ambassador Walter E. Edge in Paris reporting on the establishment of the Japanese Central Mission for Europe in Paris, set up to secure diplomatic recognition and financial assistance for Manchukuo as well as conduct press propaganda across Europe (cross-referenced to file 893.01-Manchuria/752).

subfiles.about: A State Department list of papers cataloguing documents concerning Japanese military activities, espionage, and propaganda in France during 1933.
subfiles.summary: This docket sheet records two communications filed under decimal file 894.20251 concerning Japanese military activities, propaganda, and intelligence operations in France during 1933. The first entry, dated November 20, 1933, references Japanese propaganda in France as evidenced by articles appearing in the French press. The second entry, dated January 10, 1933, records a telegram from Ambassador Walter E. Edge in Paris reporting the formation of the Japanese Central Mission for Europe to seek diplomatic recognition and financial assistance for Manchukuo and conduct press propaganda, cross-referenced to file 893.01-Manchuria/752.
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Military Activities of Japan in France
